In this glossary, Xe cung cấp nước refers to: Ground-service trolley supplying potable-water fill or grey-water drain for aircraft tanks.

How is Xe cung cấp nước used in aviation?

Definition

Ground-service trolley supplying potable-water fill or grey-water drain for aircraft tanks.

Operational example

Ground, water service cart delayed; potable tanks at sixty-percent, request expedited refill to one-hundred before passenger boarding commences.
